The underlying system

Not a flat image in space. These are 180,000 samples of the actual three-dimensional Chen–Čelikovský system, integrated with a fixed-step fourth-order Runge–Kutta method.

ẋ = 36(y − x)
ẏ = 20y − xz
ż = xy − 3z

Inspired by Paul Bourke's October 2010 reference. Height colors the orbit; luminous pulses are an artistic lighting effect, not physical particles. The chaotic trajectory is fixed. The camera and light return smoothly every loop.
